run_kinematic_trajectory_optimization: run kinematic trajectory optimization for a Franka Panda robot to reach a desired end-effector goal pose
create_KinematicModel: create a KinematicModel that predicts end-effector position given joint state and action deltas using DifferentiableFrankaPanda
run_KinematicModel_rollout: run a rollout of action sequences through the KinematicModel to generate end-effector and joint state trajectories
create_DenseGoalCost: create a DenseGoalCost function that computes the mean squared distance between a trajectory and a goal state
execute_pybullet_simulation: execute an optimized action trajectory in a PyBullet simulation with position control for the Franka Panda robot
